你正在收听的是《隐藏的大脑》（Hidden Brain）。
我是尚卡尔·维丹塔姆（Shankar Vedantam）。

sentences.en: Over many years of practice at Stanford University, psychiatrist Ana Lemke has found that lots of people living in the Bay Area, one of the wealthiest parts of the United States,
sentences.zh: 在斯坦福大学多年的执业过程中，精神科医生安娜·莱姆克（Ana Lemke）发现，许多住在旧金山湾区——美国最富裕地区之一——的人，

sentences.en: were suffering from a strange malady.
sentences.zh: 都患有一种奇怪的疾病。

sentences.en: Despite being blessed with great success in terms of education and material wealth, many of her patients were unhappy.
sentences.zh: 尽管他们在教育和物质财富方面都非常成功，但她的许多病人却并不快乐。

sentences.en: At one point, Ana saw something in herself that reminded her of the patients she was treating.
sentences.zh: 有一次，安娜在自己身上看到了一些东西，让她想起了她正在治疗的病人。

sentences.en: Ana, I want to zoom into your life around the time you turned 40.
sentences.zh: 安娜，我想深入了解一下你 40 岁左右的那段生活。

sentences.en: What was going on in your life at this time?
sentences.zh: 那时你的生活是什么样的？

sentences.en: You know, my marriage was fine.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我的婚姻很美满。

sentences.en: My work was rewarding and meaningful.
sentences.zh: 我的工作既有回报又有意义。

sentences.en: I was in relatively good health for a 40-ish-year-old woman.
sentences.zh: 作为一个 40 岁左右的女性，我的身体状况也相对不错。

sentences.en: And around this time, you fell in love with a very popular book series.
sentences.zh: 大约在那个时候，你爱上了一套非常受欢迎的系列丛书。

sentences.en: And can you tell me a little bit about what the Twilight Saga is?
sentences.zh: 你能跟我简单介绍一下《暮光之城》讲的是什么吗？

sentences.en: I confess I have not read the books.
sentences.zh: 我承认我没读过这些书。
它们的大致情节是什么？

sentences.en: Well, you know, I was turned on to the Twilight Saga when I dropped my kids off at elementary school and there was a group of moms clustered around.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道，我是有一次送孩子去小学时接触到《暮光之城》的，当时有一群妈妈聚在一起。

sentences.en: Megan was one of the moms, my friend.
sentences.zh: 梅根（Megan）是其中一位妈妈，也是我的朋友。

sentences.en: And they were all laughing hysterically.
sentences.zh: 她们当时都在歇斯底里地大笑。

sentences.en: And I went over and I said, hey, what's so funny?
sentences.zh: 我走过去问：嘿，什么事这么好笑？

sentences.en: And Megan said, oh, I've been reading this romance novel that I absolutely love.
sentences.zh: 梅根说：哦，我正在读一本我非常喜欢的爱情小说。

sentences.en: And I went into the bookstore to try to get the sequel.
So I went up to the bookstore owner and I said, hey, you know, where's the sequel?
sentences.zh: 于是我问书店老板：嘿，你知道续集在哪里吗？

sentences.en: And he said, it's in the teenager section.
So all the moms started cracking up.
sentences.zh: 所有的妈妈都开始大笑起来。

sentences.en: They thought that was the funniest thing.
But she said, but you guys have to read it.
sentences.zh: 但她说：你们一定要读读看。

sentences.en: So I said, okay, Megan, what is it called?
sentences.zh: 所以我说：好吧，梅根，它叫什么名字？

sentences.en: Because I'm always looking for a good read, right?
sentences.zh: 因为我一直在找好书看，对吧？

sentences.en: She said, oh, it's called The Twilight Saga.
sentences.zh: 她说：哦，叫《暮光之城》系列。

sentences.en: So I thought, okay, I'll give it a try.
sentences.zh: 我想，好吧，那我就试试看。

sentences.en: And it was absolutely mesmerizing for me.
It was as if I had never read a novel in my life.
sentences.zh: 就好像我这辈子从来没读过小说一样。

sentences.en: And all of a sudden, this novel about a bunch of teenage vampires running around biting each other on the neck just absolutely transported me.
sentences.zh: 突然之间，这本关于一群青少年吸血鬼跑来跑去互相咬脖子的小说，彻底让我沉浸其中。

sentences.en: So the Twilight books eventually spawned a very popular series of filMs.
sentences.zh: 后来，《暮光之城》系列书还衍生出了一系列非常受欢迎的电影。

sentences.en: I want to play you a clip from one of those movies.
sentences.zh: 我想给你放一段电影片段。

sentences.en: A teenage girl named Bella is confronting a boy she knows, Edward, about his true nature.
sentences.zh: 一个叫贝拉（Bella）的少女正在质问她认识的一个男孩爱德华（Edward），关于他的真实身份。

sentences.en: Okay, so there are a lot of, you know, breathless pauses here, but I'm hearing, you know, fantasy, paranormal stuff.
sentences.zh: 好吧，这里有很多那种屏住呼吸的停顿，但我听到的是奇幻、超自然之类的东西。

sentences.en: But it sounds like an innocent enough pastime, Anna.
sentences.zh: 但这听起来是个挺无害的消遣啊，安娜。

sentences.en: And of course, you know, it was, but what happened was it changed the way I felt in the moment in a way that resonated so deeply that I wanted to keep recreating that feeling.
sentences.zh: 当然，你知道，确实如此，但它改变了我当下的感受，这种共鸣如此深刻，以至于我想要不断地重温那种感觉。

sentences.en: It was essentially a feeling of non-being.
sentences.zh: 本质上是一种“非我”的感觉。

sentences.en: While I was reading the Twilight Saga, it just transported me to another time and place such that I completely forgot myself.
sentences.zh: 当我读《暮光之城》时，它把我带到了另一个时间和空间，以至于我完全忘记了自我。

sentences.en: And that self-forgetting was clearly something that I needed and wanted.
sentences.zh: 而那种忘我显然是我需要且想要的。

sentences.en: You know, I read the whole saga.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我读完了整个系列。

sentences.en: I think it's like four books.
And then I wanted to recreate that feeling again, so I read the whole saga again.
sentences.zh: 然后我想再次重温那种感觉，所以我又把整个系列读了一遍。

sentences.en: Pleasurable, but not as pleasurable as the first time around.
sentences.zh: 很享受，但没有第一次那么享受了。

sentences.en: But by then, I was completely tapped into this whole genre of vampire romance novels.
sentences.zh: 但到那时，我已经完全沉迷于整个吸血鬼爱情小说类型了。

sentences.en: And so I started to invest larger and larger amounts of time, energy, and creativity into obtaining and reading vampire romance novels.
sentences.zh: 于是我开始投入越来越多的时间、精力和创造力去寻找和阅读吸血鬼爱情小说。

sentences.en: You know, seemingly innocent to start with, but it became a bit of an obsession.
sentences.zh: 你知道，起初看起来很无害，但后来变成了一种执念。

sentences.en: And when I ran out of vampire romance novels, I moved on to werewolf romance novels.
sentences.zh: 当我读完吸血鬼爱情小说后，我就转而去看狼人爱情小说。

sentences.en: And then there was necromancers and soothsayers and all kinds of paranormal romance novels.
sentences.zh: 然后还有死灵法师、占卜师以及各种各样的超自然爱情小说。

sentences.en: Where were you procuring these books?
sentences.zh: 你从哪里弄到这些书的？

sentences.en: So I live right next to a little library, which has a limited collection.
sentences.zh: 我就住在一家小图书馆旁边，那里的藏书有限。

sentences.en: So when I went through the limited collection at my local library, I either biked over to the main library or you can order through the interlibrary loan.
sentences.zh: 所以当我读完当地图书馆的有限藏书后，我就骑车去总馆，或者通过馆际互借订购。

sentences.en: And, you know, some of these romance novels have very revealing covers.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，有些爱情小说的封面非常露骨。

sentences.en: Like it was some bodice ripper with some hunk on the cover, you know, at the prow of a ship or something.
sentences.zh: 就像那种封面上有个猛男、在船头之类的“撕衣”小说。

sentences.en: Like, I wouldn't want to be seen reading that anywhere.
sentences.zh: 我可不想在任何地方被人看到我在读那种书。

sentences.en: So Anna came up with a way to hide what she was reading from her family and friends.
sentences.zh: 于是安娜想出了一个办法，向家人和朋友隐藏她正在读的东西。

sentences.en: I haven't revealed this to anybody.
sentences.zh: 我还没向任何人透露过这一点。

sentences.en: But I would actually put the book inside another book so that if one of my kids came by or my husband came by, I could look like I was reading the other book.
sentences.zh: 但我实际上会把书藏在另一本书里，这样如果我的孩子或丈夫走过来，我就能装作在读那本正经的书。

sentences.en: Wow, like a medical journal or something.
sentences.zh: 哇，就像医学杂志之类的？

sentences.en: Except that might not really trick them because, like, you know, they would know that I wouldn't spend that much time reading a medical journal.
sentences.zh: 不过那可能骗不了他们，因为他们知道我不会花那么多时间看医学杂志。

sentences.en: I mean, I used to do this in eighth grade, Anna.
sentences.zh: 安娜，我八年级的时候也这么干过。

sentences.en: I felt like, you know, the trick of the book inside the book was something I had perfected in eighth grade.
sentences.zh: 我觉得把书藏在书里的把戏，我在八年级时就已经练得炉火纯青了。

sentences.en: And I discovered it in my 40s.
sentences.zh: 而我是在 40 多岁时才发现这个方法的。

sentences.en: So at one point, Anna, your love of this literature received a turbo charge when you moved from the printed page to the electronic domain.
sentences.zh: 那么安娜，当你从纸质书转向电子书时，你对这种文学的热爱得到了极大的“涡轮增压”。
告诉我这是怎么发生的。

sentences.en: Well, my friend Susan said, Anna, you should get a Kindle because then you don't have to, you know, be carrying these books around.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我的朋友苏珊（Susan）说：安娜，你应该买个 Kindle，这样你就不用随身带着这些书了。

sentences.en: Kindles had just come out then.
And, of course, that was very – I liked that idea because it would be easy access.
sentences.zh: 当然，这很不错——我很喜欢这个主意，因为获取起来很方便。

sentences.en: But pretty soon I also started regularly going on Amazon and looking for, you know, things that were similar to the Twilight Saga.
sentences.zh: 但很快，我也开始经常上亚马逊，寻找那些和《暮光之城》类似的东西。

sentences.en: Amazon will suggest those to you, as we all know now.
sentences.zh: 正如我们现在所知，亚马逊会向你推荐这些书。

sentences.en: And so Amazon did the work for me.
sentences.zh: 所以亚马逊替我完成了工作。

sentences.en: All I had to do was look in my feed and say, oh, they're telling me I should read this one.
sentences.zh: 我所要做的就是看看我的推送，然后说：哦，他们建议我读这本。

sentences.en: They're telling me I should read that one.
And like later on in the process, I also discovered that you can get free books on Amazon.
sentences.zh: 后来我还发现，在亚马逊上可以免费下载书籍。

sentences.en: So anything that was free that was in the romance category, I would download and read.
sentences.zh: 所以只要是爱情类别的免费书，我都会下载来读。

sentences.en: And that was really the beginning of the end for me because once I had that electronic reader, I essentially became a chain reader.
sentences.zh: 那对我来说真的是末日的开始，因为一旦有了电子阅读器，我基本上就成了“连环阅读者”。

sentences.en: Like as soon as I finished one book, I would either borrow from the local library or buy on Amazon another book.
sentences.zh: 一旦读完一本书，我就会从当地图书馆借或者在亚马逊上买下一本。

sentences.en: Like these were all romance novels.
And I got to a point where whenever I wasn't doing something that I absolutely had to do, like for my work or my family, I was reading romance novels.
sentences.zh: 我到了那种地步，只要不是必须要做的工作或家庭琐事，我都在读爱情小说。

sentences.en: And then it got to where, like, that's all I wanted to do.
sentences.zh: 后来发展到，我只想做这件事。

sentences.en: And I didn't enjoy anything else.
sentences.zh: 我对其他任何事情都不感兴趣。

sentences.en: I didn't even really want to, like, be with my kids or my husband, right?
sentences.zh: 我甚至不想和我的孩子或丈夫待在一起，对吧？

sentences.en: I just wanted those times to rush through them so that I could go back to reading romance novels.
sentences.zh: 我只想快点打发掉那些时间，好让我回去读爱情小说。

sentences.en: The other thing that I only realized in retrospect was that these sort of tamer versions of romance where, you know, the sex scenes aren't super graphic.
sentences.zh: 另一件事我事后才意识到，那就是那些比较温和的爱情小说，你知道，性描写并不太露骨的那种。

sentences.en: Well, those stopped working for me.
sentences.zh: 嗯，那些对我来说已经没用了。

sentences.en: And now I needed ever more graphic types of romance novels in order to get that zing that I was looking for.
sentences.zh: 现在我需要更露骨的爱情小说，才能获得我想要的那种快感。

sentences.en: So this was no longer about the pleasure of reading at this point or your love of language.
sentences.zh: 所以这在当时已经不再是关于阅读的乐趣或你对语言的热爱了。
它已经变成了别的东西。

sentences.en: Oh, it had absolutely become something else.
sentences.zh: 哦，它绝对变成了别的东西。

sentences.en: And, of course, it was rooted in the pleasure of reading and the pleasure that I've always gotten from fiction.
sentences.zh: 当然，它最初确实植根于阅读的乐趣，以及我一直以来从小说中获得的快乐。

sentences.en: But what happened was I got to a point where I really didn't care if it was badly written or badly plotted or the characters were uninteresting.
sentences.zh: 但后来我发现，我根本不在乎它写得好不好、情节烂不烂，或者角色是否无趣。

sentences.en: I would just flip through to the climax, pun intended.
sentences.zh: 我只会直接翻到高潮部分，一语双关。

sentences.en: So then I got to where I was, like, reading really graphic erotica.
sentences.zh: 后来我就开始读非常露骨的色情文学了。

sentences.en: And the more graphic, the better.
The more sex scenes, the better.
But it was all about getting to that moment and getting a certain very specific feeling.
sentences.zh: 但这完全是为了达到那个时刻，获得一种非常特定的感觉。

sentences.en: And I became the possessor of the knowledge that if you take any romance novel and you open it up to two-thirds or three-quarters of the way through, you know,
sentences.zh: 我掌握了一个秘诀，如果你拿起任何一本爱情小说，翻到三分之二或四分之三处，你知道，

sentences.en: you'll get right to the point.
sentences.zh: 你就能直接看到重点了。

sentences.en: Which is to say these romance novels are engineered.
sentences.zh: 也就是说，这些言情小说都是精心设计的。

sentences.en: They're written according to a recipe.
sentences.zh: 它们是按照配方写出来的。

sentences.en: So at this point, you know, you're a respected researcher and psychiatrist at Stanford University.
sentences.zh: 所以当时，你已经是斯坦福大学受人尊敬的研究员和精神科医生了。

sentences.en: But that's what I want to ask you about.
sentences.zh: 但这正是我想要问你的。

sentences.en: You know, you have, you know, what you are doing in some ways must have felt at odds with your public persona, the sense that you had that you were a mom,
sentences.zh: 你知道，你在某种程度上所做的事情，一定让你感到与你的公众形象不符，那种你觉得自己是一位母亲的感觉，

sentences.en: that you had a great family.
Were you embarrassed by your newfound love of steamy literature?
sentences.zh: 你是否因为自己新发现的对这种火辣文学的热爱而感到尴尬？

sentences.en: First of all, I didn't really see what was happening as it was happening.
sentences.zh: 首先，当事情发生时，我并没有真正意识到发生了什么。

sentences.en: I would occasionally joke to friends, oh, I'm so addicted to vampire romance novels or romance novels in general.
sentences.zh: 我偶尔会和朋友开玩笑说，哦，我太沉迷于吸血鬼言情小说或一般的言情小说了。

sentences.en: But just by being able to joke about it, I felt that that must mean I'm really not addicted to it or it's not really a problem.
sentences.zh: 但仅仅因为能拿它开玩笑，我就觉得这意味着我并没有真正沉迷其中，或者它并不是什么大问题。

sentences.en: The other thing was that because of the technology in large part, I could do the behavior secretly.
sentences.zh: 另一件事是，在很大程度上由于科技的原因，我可以秘密地进行这种行为。

sentences.en: Once I got the Kindle, you know, I could be reading something on that Kindle that nobody else knew what I was reading.
sentences.zh: 一旦我有了Kindle，你知道，我可以在Kindle上读一些东西，没人知道我在读什么。

sentences.en: Whereas before, I wouldn't want to be seen reading that anywhere.
sentences.zh: 而在此之前，我不想在任何地方被看到在读那些东西。

sentences.en: That would just be really embarrassing.
But on a Kindle, like it was anonymous.
How did this affect your patient care?
sentences.zh: 这对你的病人护理有什么影响？

sentences.en: Because presumably through all of this, you were still treating other patients and helping people with their addictions.
sentences.zh: 因为据推测，在这一切过程中，你仍然在治疗其他病人，帮助人们克服他们的成瘾问题。

sentences.en: As it was happening, I didn't really see it happening.
sentences.zh: 当它发生时，我并没有真正意识到它在发生。

sentences.en: And I didn't relate it as being similar to what my patients were going through.
sentences.zh: 而且我没有把它与我的病人所经历的事情联系起来。

sentences.en: That I really only saw in retrospect.
sentences.zh: 我真的只是事后才看出来的。

sentences.en: But I started to be less interested in my work.
sentences.zh: 但我开始对我的工作不那么感兴趣了。

sentences.en: Like, again, the work that had given me meaning and purpose and joy started to be dull and gray and boring.
sentences.zh: 就像，再次强调，曾经赋予我意义、目标和快乐的工作开始变得沉闷、灰暗和无聊。

sentences.en: And I found myself less engaged and more just wanting to rush through the work so that I could go home and read romance novels.
sentences.zh: 我发现自己投入的精力减少了，更多地只是想匆匆完成工作，这样我就可以回家读言情小说了。

sentences.en: So you weren't reading these at work?
sentences.zh: 所以你不在工作时读这些书？

sentences.en: You reserved the reading at home?
Well, there was one day, and this was sort of near the sort of culmination of this behavior.
sentences.zh: 嗯，有一天，这差不多是这种行为的高潮阶段。

sentences.en: Time is weird for me then, but I think it developed over the course of about a year or two.
sentences.zh: 那时我对时间的感知很奇怪，但我认为它是在一两年内发展起来的。

sentences.en: But I did bring a romance novel to work and was reading in the 10 minutes between patients.
sentences.zh: 但我确实带了一本言情小说去上班，在病人之间的10分钟空隙里阅读。

sentences.en: So, I don't want to play armchair psychiatrist, but it seems that you were...
sentences.zh: 所以，我不想充当业余精神病学家，但看起来你当时……

sentences.en: You know, you were using your emotion in these books as a kind of escape.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你是在把这些书里的情感当作一种逃避。

sentences.en: What do you think you were escaping from?

sentences.zh: 嗯，这正是最迷人的地方。

sentences.en: I really didn't have anything to escape from.
sentences.zh: 我真的没有什么可逃避的。

sentences.en: I have got these great kids.
I have work that I adore.
My patients are just so fantastic.
sentences.zh: 我的病人们真是太棒了。
没有什么不对劲的地方。

sentences.en: I was really just escaping to.
sentences.zh: 我真的只是在逃避到别处去。

sentences.en: And the thing that I was escaping to was just not having to be in my body, not having to think,
sentences.zh: 而我逃避到的地方，只是不必身处自己的身体里，不必思考，

sentences.en: being able to experience this kind of intense euphoria, you know, this other place,
sentences.zh: 能够体验这种强烈的欣快感，你知道，这个别处，

sentences.en: which was very, very pleasant for me.
sentences.zh: 这对我来说非常非常愉快。

sentences.en: The other thing I just want to flag here is that the pattern we've seen over and over again,
sentences.zh: 我在这里想指出的另一件事是，我们反复看到的模式，

sentences.en: which is that something starts out being pleasurable.
sentences.zh: 那就是某件事一开始是令人愉悦的。

sentences.en: So, your friend tells you about this romance novel.
sentences.zh: 所以，你的朋友告诉你这本言情小说。

sentences.en: And so, you go back for more.
sentences.zh: 所以，你又回去读了更多。

sentences.en: But somewhere along this process, sort of the balance shifts.
sentences.zh: 但在这一过程中的某个地方，平衡发生了偏移。

sentences.en: And now you're no longer actually reading these things because they're giving you pleasure.
